aboutPage.title: About Indexia Group
aboutPage.subtitle: A diversified Indian business group committed to integrity, expertise, and a people-first approach — spanning finance, export, agriculture, warehousing, security, advertising, and athlete support.
aboutPage.companiesSubtitle: From a single financial services company in Mumbai to a diversified group of eight businesses — each built on the same foundation of integrity, expertise, and results.
aboutPage.c1Body: Founded in 2012, Indexia Finance is India's largest international finance company with 5 branches across 4 cities. As a multinational fintech platform, it partners with 43+ banks and NBFCs to deliver personal loans, business loans, home loans, loan against property, balance transfer, car loans, credit cards, education loans, project loans, commercial purchase, lease rental discounting, and working capital solutions. The company operates globally across India, the US, Ecuador, South America, Amsterdam, Europe, and London. Winner of the Best Finance Company 2016 award at the Capital First Limited Leadership Awards.
aboutPage.c1Highlights: 43+ Lender Partners,5 Branches in 4 Cities,Best Finance Company 2016 Award,Global Presence: India, US, Ecuador, Europe
aboutPage.c2Body: Indexia Finserve is the dedicated lending arm of the Indexia Group, offering every kind of loan under finance. The company works as a complete loan destination, guiding clients through eligibility, documentation, and disbursal for personal, home, business, MSME, and specialised funding with a single, streamlined process. From personal loans to working capital, Indexia Finserve makes the right bank come to your doorstep.
aboutPage.c2Highlights: 12 Loan Products,Personal & Business Loans,Home Loan & LAP,Balance Transfer & Working Capital
aboutPage.c3Body: Indexia Overseas is the global export arm of the Indexia Group, specializing in the international trade of refined sugar and premium edible commodities. With a strong and growing presence across 14 South American countries, the company has built a reputation for reliability, quality, and efficiency in cross-border food supply chains. From sourcing and quality assurance to international warehousing and regulatory compliance, Indexia Overseas manages every stage of the export process.
aboutPage.c3Highlights: 14 South American Countries,Premium Refined Sugar Export,Food-Grade Quality Certified,Full-Cycle Export Management
aboutPage.c4Name: Indexia Agro Bio Fertilizers Pvt. Ltd.
aboutPage.c4Body: Indexia Agro Bio Fertilizers is committed to transforming Indian agriculture through scientifically formulated, eco-friendly bio-fertilizers. Operating from its state-of-the-art production facility in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh — strategically located within the Delhi NCR belt — the company manufactures a comprehensive range of organic fertilizers that restore depleted soil, enhance microbial activity, and significantly improve crop productivity.
aboutPage.c4Highlights: 100% Organic Bio-Fertilizers,Production in Shamli UP (Delhi NCR),Soil Testing & Farmer Support,Domestic & Export Distribution
aboutPage.c5Body: Indexia Securities is a premier security solutions provider specializing in armed protection, commando deployment, and comprehensive security management. Staffed by ex-military commandos and rigorously trained security professionals, the company safeguards high-profile individuals — including politicians, corporate leaders, and public figures — as well as critical infrastructure, corporate facilities, and large-scale events. The company operates a 24×7 monitoring and response centre.
aboutPage.c5Highlights: Ex-Military Commandos,24/7 Operations Centre,VIP & Corporate Protection,Critical Infrastructure Security
aboutPage.c6Body: Indexia Warehouse offers a strategic land leasing opportunity in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh — just ~65 km from Delhi. The location is a connectivity hub: 8 national expressways and 2 major highways connecting 8 states, with direct access to Bhutan and Nepal and a market reach of 50 crore people. The land portfolio spans 5 locations and 21 acres total, with flexible plots and a modern warehouse to be built on 2 acres.
aboutPage.c6Highlights: 21 Acres in Shamli UP,8 National Expressways,5 Locations,65 km from Delhi
aboutPage.c7Body: Indexia Advertising operates premium single-pole unipole hoardings on the Delhi–Dehradun Highway (NH-709B) in Shamli — the hub of North India. Positioned at the junction of 8 national expressways and 2 major highways, the unipoles connect 10 states with a 50 crore population reach and attract 1+ crore daily exposure. Single-pole unipoles with premium height and unobstructed 360° viewing angles give brands maximum visibility.
aboutPage.c7Highlights: NH-709B Delhi-Dehradun Highway,10 States Connected,360° Visibility Unipoles,1+ Crore Daily Exposure
aboutPage.c8Body: Indexia Foundation is the social impact arm of the Indexia Group, dedicated to identifying, nurturing, and supporting Indian athletes on their journey from grassroots talent to international competition — including the Olympic Games. The foundation provides a complete support ecosystem: international-level training facilities, structured nutrition and diet planning, expert coaching and mentorship, sports science and medical support, competition funding, and psychological guidance.
aboutPage.c8Highlights: Grassroots to Olympics,Training & Nutrition,Coaching & Mentorship,Competition Funding
aboutPage.founderBio1: Built Indexia Group on a simple but powerful idea: that Indian businesses can compete globally when they are built on integrity, deep expertise, and a genuine commitment to the people they serve. Starting with a single financial services company in Mumbai, the group has grown into eight diverse businesses spanning finance, export, agriculture, warehousing, security, advertising, and social impact.
aboutPage.founderBio2: Leading operational excellence and strategic growth across all companies in the group, ensuring every business delivers on its promise of reliability, transparency, and results. Under this leadership, Indexia Group has expanded to three locations — Mumbai, Delhi, and Ecuador — and built a team united by a common purpose, serving clients and partners worldwide.
aboutPage.founderQuote: Business is about trust. When you build on integrity, everything else follows.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From a Shared Vision to a National Group
aboutPage.storyBody1: Indexia Group was founded with a simple belief: that Indian businesses can compete globally when built on integrity, expertise, and a genuine commitment to the people they serve. What started as a single financial services company has grown into a diversified group of eight businesses spanning finance, export, agriculture, warehousing, security, advertising, and social impact.
aboutPage.storyBody2: Today, Indexia Group operates across three locations — Mumbai, Delhi, and Ecuador — with a team that shares a common purpose: to deliver results that matter. Every company in the group carries the same DNA — transparency, reliability, and a relentless focus on creating value for clients, partners, and communities.
aboutPage.value1Body: We do what we say. Every relationship is built on honesty, transparency, and mutual respect — with clients, partners, and each other.
aboutPage.value2Body: We invest in deep domain knowledge across every vertical. Our teams bring specialised skills and industry experience to every engagement.
aboutPage.value3Body: Business is ultimately about people. We design solutions that empower our clients, support our communities, and create meaningful opportunities for our team.
aboutPage.value4Body: We embrace change and continuously improve. From fintech platforms to organic agriculture, we invest in ideas that move industries forward.
aboutPage.milestone1Body: Indexia Group established its first company in Mumbai, starting with financial services and lending.
aboutPage.milestone2Body: Expanded operations to Delhi NCR, launching Finserve and building a pan-India lending network.
aboutPage.milestone3Body: Entered international markets with sugar exports to South America and opened an office in Ecuador.
aboutPage.milestone4Body: Launched Agro Bio, Securities, Warehouse, and Advertising verticals — growing to eight companies.
aboutPage.milestone5Body: Founded Indexia Foundation to support Indian athletes from grassroots to the Olympic Games.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Whether you're looking for financial services, exploring a partnership, or simply want to learn more about our group — we're here to help.
aboutPage.registrationSubtitle: All Indexia Group companies are registered under the Companies Act, 2013 with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India.
